acceptance: A bounded evidence query joins trace events with an explicitly selected public job registry using opaque job and parent-job identifiers.
Nested execution, retries, missing/malformed/inaccessible/inconsistent registry links, and trace mismatches remain explicit and bounded.
Registry and trace output excludes paths, logs, prompts, responses, tools, secrets, and arbitrary unsafe values while preserving existing exact-ID session and trace behavior.
Provider-free fixtures cover nested launches, retry attempts, malformed and unavailable registry evidence, privacy, cycles, duplicates, and output limits.
